segments.en: No, Carrie Underwood might be known for her Grammy award-winning music 8 times a Grammy winner, but she's also pushing into the wellness space through her new brand called High Note.
segments.zh: 不，Carrie Underwood可能以八次获得格莱美奖的音乐闻名，但她也在通过新品牌HiNote进军健康领域。

segments.en: It's a lifestyle and nutrition company that's just secured a new investment to expand production of its flagship drink mix. I saw down with Carrie and Carrie in Barons,
segments.zh: 这是一家生活方式和营养公司，刚刚获得新**，用于扩大其旗舰饮品混合物的生产。我采访了Carrie和Carrie在Barons，

segments.zh: HiNote的联合创始人兼CEO，谈论了品牌的创立和未来计划。

segments.en: I've been excited about health and wellness for really my whole life, but I started making it
segments.zh: 我一直对健康充满热情，但我在20多岁时开始把它作为优先事项。

segments.en: a priority in my 20s. And I feel like I've learned a lot along the way. I continue to learn, but basically, you know, wanted to share some of the things that I've learned over my own journey
segments.zh: 我觉得我一路学到了很多。我继续学习，但基本上，我想分享一些我在自己旅程中学到的东西

segments.en: with people. We started a fitness app and kind of through that, we branched out and we created
segments.zh: 与人们。我们创办了一个健身应用，通过它，我们拓展并创建了

segments.en: High Note Life. And we are always expanding, always learning. We wanted to create things that
segments.zh: HiNote Life。我们一直在扩展，一直在学习。我们想创造一些

segments.en: could meet consumers where they were and just help, help, help, help people get healthy.
segments.zh: 能够满足消费者需求的东西，只是帮助、帮助、帮助、帮助人们获得健康。

segments.en: And I love that your catchphrase or one of them is making wellness doable. And I think that will resonate with a lot of people that are maybe just starting out on their journey.
segments.zh: 我喜欢你的口号之一：让健康变得可行。我认为这会引起很多可能刚刚开始旅程的人的共鸣。
